beam_policy.running_eighths: Two groups at 0..5/2 and3..11/2 in regular six-quarter bars. Single notes/rests terminate groups. Preserve cross-staff groups in P004,P008,P078. P034 six then four eighths. P038/P042/P044-P050 groups1.5..2.5 and4.5..5.5; P039/P043 first run group1.5..2.5 then3..5.5. P086 four opening eighths, five closing eighths; P087 singleton. beam_policy.stems: Held upper melody up, inner upper moving line down; bass melody up over held line down. Single running upper low-register lines follow print upstem; independent bass running lines upstem. Exact exceptions in inspection records.
